records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: desktop-pet character art direction, three-expression preview only.
Draw a NEW ORIGINAL illustration, NOT an edit of any prior generated pig. Deliberately reject generic glossy mobile-game pig clipart. Make an appealingly goofy, expressive flat 2D meme pig: a compact upright-ish pear/bean silhouette with the face occupying most of the upper front, peach-pink solid skin, two floppy U-shaped rosy ears, broad saturated pink oval snout centered BELOW the eyes, two neat charcoal oval nostrils, teeny stubby feet, tiny curled tail. The face must clearly be a FACE, not detached facial features spread over a realistic sideways pig's torso. Use a simplified three-quarter view, gently leaning toward viewer, same one character design and silhouette in all three.
Style: confident hand-drawn character-design linework; smooth rounded charcoal-plum outlines of consistent intentional thickness; clean flat color shapes; a few pink cheek hatch marks; NO airbrush, NO soft gradient, NO plastic gloss, NO shiny 3D, NO dense shadow, NO rim light, NO beige paper, NO decorative sticker outline, NO speckles. Humor is dry, stupid-cute, a little dramatic and instantly readable at small desktop-pet size, rather than baby-product branding.
Layout: a landscape transparent PNG with three full-body pigs arranged horizontally, equal size and generous empty transparent gutters. Clean isolated alpha, each character wholly inside the canvas, no ground shadow. No text, captions, symbols, cards, grid, border, costumes, or props.
Left: blank bean-eyed stare, slightly asymmetrical brow and very tiny neutral mouth, face of a pig with absolutely no thoughts.
Center: theatrically wronged crying pig; large black oval eyes with two small watery white highlights, inverted-V inner brows, two broad vivid blue tear streams and a small trembling pout immediately beneath the snout; adorable expressive melodrama, NOT suffering.
Right: self-satisfied mischievous pig; sharply half-lidded sideways eyes, one raised eyebrow, broad lopsided confident grin immediately beneath the snout, round cheeks lightly lifted, smug but harmless.
The three emotional readings must be extremely different while clearly using the SAME base pig. Expressions flow with the head's curves. Exactly two eyes, one snout, two nostrils, one mouth on the lower face. No mouth on belly, no random facial fragments. Favor iconic flat graphic design and comedic appeal over intricate rendering.
Deliver only this three-character concept preview, polished clean shapes and linework, genuine alpha transparency. Not a sprite atlas or release-ready claim.
